Monn.rules: All eight configured strategy orders retain their original SL and optional TP, including original fix_order/max_sl_pct configuration. No TP is added when absent.

mt5_live_trading_bot.rules: All eight Sunrise profiles retain their original stop_level and take_level.

Forex-Trading-Bot.rules: SuperTrend retains its original average-line TP and reward/1.2 SL formula.

tradingbot/donchian.rules: Native Donchian state machine exposes its fixed original entry-close +/- stop_atr * ATR(atr_n) stop: defaults 2.5 * ATR(48). Reuse that original signal-entry anchor for additions, not a new ATR stop. Convert mid level to bid/ask trigger using current half-spread. No fixed TP exists, so new orders carry TP=0. Missing/invalid native stops skip entries without fallback. The broker stop can trigger intrabar; upstream state uses closed-bar comparisons.

tradingbot/other.rules: ema_cross, tsmom, kalman_trend, zscore_fade, rsi2, bollinger_revert, vol_squeeze, orb and managed_gold expose forecasts/state exits rather than standalone broker SL/TP rules. Retain the existing 2 * ATR(14) SL and 4 * ATR(14) TP.

MT5-Python-Trading.rules: crossover, smc, trend_breakout and combined expose direction only. Original multi_symbol_robot sends sl=None/tp=None; its stop_loss_pips is a sizing input, not an attached protection rule. Retain existing 2 * ATR(14) SL and 4 * ATR(14) TP.

migration.rules: Existing broker positions keep their SL/TP. No stop widening/removal, mass position updates, forecast/time/channel liquidation, risk-budget change, halt reset, ownership change or decision replay. Dynamic/signal exits are not represented as invented static TP prices.

aegisquant.rules: 29 literal strategy/controller modules; market/structural/ATR protection remains strategy-specific. Controllers emit routing/filter intents and are not extra P&L streams. Pending orders and unqualified multi-leg execution are not silently emulated. Shared3.50USC risk ceiling and persistent halt remain authoritative. Native execution requires a separately verified cost/slippage/parity profile; missing prerequisites block orders.
